description.to:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** Replaces kanbus-313b10. Same account, so no sending authorization: a site's notifications function sends from the identity the newsletter's sending stack already created.

**Build.**
- Identities on 2026-11-04: `p.apyr.us`, `mail.pilobol.us`, `mail.dataparade.anth.us`, `shipped.anth.us`, `distinctive-mark.com`, `mail.machines-on-machines.anth.us`. Anth.us and Threat Intelligence have none: deploy the stack for them. Check the site list from the repo, not this note.
- Same configuration set `papyrus-<site>` as the newsletter, so one reputation and one pause per site. Add `EventTransport: both` per stack; the SNS destination goes in `PPY-819117`. A set may have several destinations.
- Tags: `site`, `kind`, `delivery`. The newsletter handler already ignores an event with no valid `sub` tag, so the two consumers do not collide; test it.
- Pause: bounce and complaint alarms exist only on sites with the newsletter plugin. A site with notifications but no newsletter gets the same alarms and pause from the notifications plugin. A send on a paused set is logged `failed` with a reason, and admins are told; check the exact SES error.
- Footer: postal address from SSM as in `docs/newsletter.md`, reason sentence, manage, unsubscribe. A missing address blocks marketing-class sends with a reason.
- Capacity is shared across the account: 14 per second and 50,000 a day on the 2026-11-04 reading. Each site's pacer reads `MaxSendRate` and can't see the others, so throttling backoff is what keeps them honest. Watch it on batch sends. Ramp: Machines on Machines, then the batch; there is no fixed cap.

**Acceptance.**
Real inbox on Machines on Machines: SPF, DKIM and DMARC pass; a simulator bounce reaches the site's delivery log and doesn't disturb the newsletter.

**Depends on:** PPY-44721a
**Related:** kanbus-06de58, kanbus-602759
